items.title: HIFI raises $37M to expand stablecoin payments, tokenized markets
items.summary: HIFI CEO Zach Walsh told Cointelegraph the $37 million Series A is the company’s first priced funding round, though HIFI did not disclose its valuation.

items.title: HIFI raises $37 million Series A to expand tokenized capital markets infrastructure
items.summary: HIFI raised $37 million in Series A funding led by Left Lane Capital to scale tokenized settlement infrastructure.

items.title: Morning Minute: Selig Says ‘It’s Go Time’ for CFTC Crypto Rules
items.summary: The CFTC has been extremely busy ever since the Clarity Act failed its vote, and it appears they’re ready to accelerate.

items.title: Brooklyn man sent to prison for 12 years for stealing $16M in a Coinbase phishing scheme
items.summary: The fraudster managed to scam about 100 people across the United States, convincing them of transferring funds to him, claiming their accounts had been hacked.
